observed.counts_weighting: all raw offdiag record counts; zero-count pairs contribute exactly zero

metric_rules.bootstrap: fixed 10000x20 index matrix; undefined chromosomes retained and full-20 estimate/CI set to null
metric_rules.inter: common-mask valid-bin factorization; sorted four-copy distance per inter locus pair; denominator 4x pair count
metric_rules.map: AA/AB/BA/BB per-pair score argmax; raw-count weighted intra/inter/all offdiag; diag excluded; Rg whole-cell 5290 physical beads
metric_rules.null: u0 plus 16 within-chromosome u permutations per source, z fixed, one global rescale only if needed
metric_rules.r2: old21 common mask at numeric 3Mb offset; four rho; per-chromosome direct/swapped selection; tie <=1e-12 unresolved
